text:
Palladium Price in 1997
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1997, the LBMA palladium price rose 64.2% between 1997-01-31 ($124) and 1997-12-30 ($203). The highest sampled price was $211 in July and the lowest was $124 in January. The mean of these observations was $180. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
